description: Find registered federal lobbyists, lobbying firms, clients (organizations that hire lobbyists), issues, agencies and bills by name. Returns matches with their Gov Relations page. Use it first to turn a name into a slug for get_firm, get_client or get_lobbyist.

query.description: A name or part of one, e.g. "Pfizer", "Akin Gump", "Jane Smith", "defense".

type.description: Limit to one kind of result. Default any.

name: search_lobbying
title: Search lobbyists, firms and clients
